propositions: Compaction leaves the tracker working tree dirty (untracked SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired files) non-atomically when the detached sweep worker is killed before commit.

The next reconverge _union_merge attempts git merge origin/tickets, but the merge must CREATE those untracked paths that already exist in the working tree, causing git to abort with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge'.

The union-merge failure handler is abort-only, and push-recovery cannot clear untracked files (git reset --hard is tracked-only, git stash without -u ignores untracked files), causing every retry to re-abort and permanently wedge the store.

The fix detects the untracked-overwrite abort signature, parses the exact paths git names, relocates them to a quarantine directory outside the worktree, and retries the merge once, allowing the union merge to complete with both parents preserved.
Real uncommitted event-appends (.tmp-event-*) live at the tracker root and do not exist on origin, so git never names them in the merge error and they are never quarantined or displaced.
Compaction must be made crash-atomic (roll back the dirty tree if the detached sweep dies before commit) in a separate follow-up to prevent the dirty state from being produced in the first place.
